name: Harunashi Mika
source:
[i]"...I'm glad you're the first person I met."[/i]

A freelance engineer who does nothing outside of work except play games, never leaving his room. 

His penchant for gaming has led to him becoming an FPS streamer. Not especially fond or trusting of other people, but a reliable friend to those he has become close with, being very protective of them as well. He had an unhappy childhood; his father spent all of his time at work, and his mother was the stereotypical helicopter parent.

Forced to participate in Navigatore after his father signs him up without his permission.

[From [url=https://www.primula.jpn.com/hounavi/en/index.html#Character]Primula[/url]]
